an10.172:1.1: Adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca,
an10.172:1.3: adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabban ti.
an10.172:1.5: idaṃ vatvā Sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram pāvisi. 2.
an10.172:2.1: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:
an10.172:2.2: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:2.5: adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabban' ti.
an10.172:2.6: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā ti?
an10.172:3.1: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
an10.172:3.2: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Mahākaccāno Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.172:3.3: pahoti cāyasmā Mahākaccāno imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.172:3.4: Yan nūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etam atthaṃ puccheyyāma.
an10.172:3.5: Yathā no āyasmā Mahākaccāno vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmā ti. 3.
an10.172:4.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Mahākaccānena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu;
an10.172:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etad avocuṃ:
an10.172:5.1: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Kaccāna Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:5.4: adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabban' ti.
an10.172:6.1: Tesaṃ no āvuso amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:
an10.172:6.2: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:6.3: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.172:6.5: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā ti?
an10.172:7.1: Tesaṃ no āvuso amhākaṃ etad ahosi:
an10.172:7.2: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Mahākaccāno Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.172:7.3: pahoti cāyasmā Mahākaccāno imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.172:7.4: Yan nūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etam atthaṃ puccheyyāma.
an10.172:7.5: Yathā no āyasmā Mahākaccāno vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmā ti.
an10.172:8.1: Seyyathā pi āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkamm' eva mūlaṃ atikkamma khandhaṃ sākhāpalāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya,
an10.172:8.2: evaṃ sampadam idaṃ. Āyasmantānaṃ Satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ Bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etam atthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññetha.
an10.172:8.3: So h' āvuso Bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī Tathāgato.
an10.172:8.4: So c' eva pan' etassa kālo ahosi, yaṃ tumhe Bhagayantaṃ yeva upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccheyyātha.
an10.172:8.5: Yathā vo Bhagavā vyākareyya, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthā ti. 5.
an10.172:9.1: Addhāvuso Kaccāna Bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī Tathāgato.
an10.172:9.2: So c' eva pan' etassa kālo ahosi, yaṃ mayaṃ Bhagavantaṃ yeva upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccheyyāma.
an10.172:9.3: Yathā no Bhagavā vyākareyya, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma.
an10.172:9.4: Api cāyasmā Mahākaccāno Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.172:9.5: pahoti cāyasmā Mahākaccāno imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.172:10.1: Tena h' āvuso suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
an10.172:10.2: ‘Evam āvuso' ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahākaccānassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.172:11.1: Yaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:11.2: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.172:12.1: Katamo cāvuso adhammo, katamo ca dhammo,
an10.172:12.2: katamo ca anattho, katamo ca attho? 7.
an10.172:12.5: ye ca pāṇātipātapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:12.6: pāṇātipātā veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:13.3: ye ca adinnādānapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:13.4: adinnādānā veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:14.3: ye ca kāmesu micchācārapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:14.4: kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:15.3: ye ca musāvādapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:15.4: musāvādā veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:16.3: ye ca pisunavācāpaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:16.4: pisunāya vācāya veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:17.3: ye ca pharusavācāpaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:17.4: pharusāya vācāya veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:18.3: ye ca samphappalāpapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:18.4: samphappalāpā veramaṇīpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:19.3: ye ca abhijjhāpaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:19.4: anabhijjhāpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:20.3: ye ca vyāpādapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:20.4: avyāpādapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:21.3: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:21.4: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:22.1: Yaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:22.2: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.172:22.4: imassa kho ahaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi,
an10.172:22.5: ākaṅkhamānā ca pana tumhe āvuso Bhagavantaṃ yeva upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccheyyātha.
an10.172:22.6: Yathā vo Bhagavā vyākaroti, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthā ti.
an10.172:23.1: ‘Evam āvuso' ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahākaccānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:-- 8.
an10.172:24.1: Yaṃ kho no bhante Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā utthāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:24.2: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.172:25.1: Tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:
an10.172:25.2: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:25.3: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.172:25.5: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā ti?
an10.172:26.1: Tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ etad ahosi:
an10.172:26.2: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Mahākaccāno Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.172:26.3: pahoti cāyasmā Mahākaccāno imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.172:26.4: Yan nūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etam atthaṃ puccheyyāma.
an10.172:26.5: Yathā no āyasmā Mahākaccāno vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmā ti.
an10.172:27.1: Atha kho mayaṃ bhante yenāyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṅkamimhā, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etam atthaṃ pucchimhā.
an10.172:27.2: Tesaṃ no bhante āyasmatā Mahākaccānena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi vyañjanehi attho suvibhatto ti. 9.
an10.172:28.2: paṇḍito bhikkhave Mahākaccāno, mahāpañño bhikkhave Mahākaccāno,
an10.172:28.3: maṃ ce pi tumhe bhikkhave upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccheyyātha, aham pi c' etaṃ evam eva vyākareyyaṃ. Yathā taṃ Mahākaccānena vyākataṃ,
an10.172:28.4: eso c' eva tassa attho, evañ ca naṃ dhāreyyāthā
